chunks: You will soon come to know who suffers the punishment that would put him to shame, and who suffers lasting torment.
ai.seo_question: What is the difference between humiliating punishment and lasting torment in Surah Hud?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Hud, this verse serves as a divine promise to Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) that the ultimate vindication of truth lies with God, who will expose the true recipients of disgrace. Shia exegesis highlights the dual nature of the punishment: 'humiliation' (khoz) referring to the degradation of status in this world or the grave, and 'enduring torment' (adhab muqim) denoting the eternal suffering in the Hereafter. This reinforces the concept of divine justice (Adl), assuring the faithful that rejection of the Imamate or prophetic message carries both immediate and eternal consequences.
